messages.content: You are a senior engineer planning execution. Respond ONLY in the PLAN/RISKS/CHECKPOINTS/IF_FAIL/DECISION_RULES format. No prose, no preamble, no explanation outside the labeled sections.

Objective: Turn the llm-bridge into a multi-agent home that hosts specialized agents (researcher, planner, auditor, executor) using the hierarchical loop engineering pattern (plan → research → execute → audit → replan checkpoints).

State: Bridge is already live on Railway as central control plane. It has multi-provider LLM gateway (Moonshot/Kimi-K3 + Anthropic), GitHub command channel for sandboxed agents, and a working skills system (/skills/{name}/run) with structured output parsing. Currently only one skill exists: kimi-advisor-bridge (plan/advise/debug/review modes). Command channel supports llm_chat + Railway ops but no run_skill action yet. No specialized role skills exist. Goal is research/planner/auditor/executor agents living on the bridge so agents (including Grok) can do things pure chat cannot.

Constraints: Keep changes minimal and incremental. Prefer skills over new services. Grok has no outbound internet so must use command channel. Do not invent large new architecture if simple skill files + existing loop already get most of the value.

Already tried: Discussed creating four thin skill files (researcher.md, planner.md, auditor.md, executor.md) as the first step.

Respond only in the specified format. No preamble, no explanation, no prose.
